title.narrative: Program to Support a Fair, Clean and Sustainable Energy Transition II
Programa de Apoyo a la Transicion Energetica Justa, Limpia y Sostenible II

description.narrative: El objetivo general es apoyar la transicin energtica justa, limpia y sostenible de Chile. Los objetivos especficos son: (i) perfeccionar el marco regulatorio del sector energtico para avanzar en su modernizacin con sello ciudadano; (ii) apoyar las reformas de poltica dirigidas a acelerar la descarbonizacin de la matriz energtica; y (iii) habilitar e impulsar la innovacin tecnolgica en el sector energa.

The general objective is to support the fair, clean and sustainable energy transition of Chile. The specific objectives are: (i) perfect the regulatory framework of the energy sector to advance in its modernization with citizen' seal; (ii) support policy reforms aimed at accelerating the decarbonization of the energy matrix; and (iii) enable and promote technological innovation in the energy sector.
